scope: Voice Companion no longer seems frozen when it starts with the microphone off.

topics.title: Problem reports
details: If Voice Companion ever stops responding, it now writes down where it got stuck.
This helps fix the problem quickly. You do not need to do anything.

topics.title: Starting with the microphone off
details: When the microphone is off, Voice Companion now starts on the main menu. The arrow keys work right away.
It no longer tells you to say wake up, since it cannot hear you.
It also takes the keyboard back when it starts, even if Thunderbird opened first.
If you say no to an update, you go to the main menu.
